body: Every tournament pays out a real cash prize pool — straight to the sharpest forecasters. No staking. Skill is the only stake.

steps.title: Forecast
steps.body: Call real-world events across sports, politics, crypto, macro and more. Every forecast sharpens your Edge Score.

steps.title: Compete
steps.body: Pick any tournament — weekly, monthly, ad hoc, or a topic you know cold. No staking — pure skill.

steps.title: Win
steps.body: Finish near the top and win real cash, paid straight out — plus the leaderboard rank and the bragging rights.
